title: RepairAction
description: Output of the Automatic Repair Engine (Cinematic Intelligence Layer, Phase 7). Produced when a QualityReport recommends a repair; scoped to exactly one shot_id - the Automatic Repair Engine never regenerates a whole project. Applying a RepairAction is what bumps a shot's PromptPackage.version.

strategy_id.description: Which IRepairStrategy plugin (REPAIR_STRATEGY_REGISTRY key) produced this action.

review_status.description: Phase 8: a human decision on whether to accept this proposed repair - distinct from `status`, which describes whether the strategy itself succeeded in computing a fix. Set by the caller (e.g. CinematicIntelligenceCoordinator.review_repair), never by IRepairStrategy itself.
